answer: Mechanism: activity-based identity aging. Weight accrues only from verified work, counted by real participation, never calendar time. A fresh identity that wants voting force must climb the ridge of cumulative attestations, grading honestly for many rounds. Sleeper fakes that idle while waiting to mature accumulate nothing and stay weightless; there is no shortcut, no oasis where time alone ripens an account. An attacker's horde stays inert unless each member works, which turns a sybil army into unpaid reviewers; old-idle accounts rank as relics, honored in history yet powerless in consensus.
